scope: Independent read-only review of E02 test composition-root diagnostic/readiness changes only; not product/native cancellation implementation
conclusion: No blocking finding within reviewed fixture-diagnostic scope. Process execution report is retained separately from watcher status; missing/late readiness cannot transfer an admitted value.

static_findings.result: Completion send occurs after execute_process_validated returns. recv_timeout wakes the scoped watcher on finish/disconnect; marker cancellation may win or return AlreadyFinished. A readiness failure suppresses the returned value while retaining the original execution admission/report. The marker-vs-completion race is conservative rejection, not false admission.
Watcher joined in all normal result paths; panic is represented as WatcherPanicked, rather than replacing execution diagnostics. Existing process budgets and product cleanup implementation unchanged.

Original rejection/cancellation/terminal assertions remain. Cancellation tests additionally require no harness error and observed marker with Requested/AlreadyRequested. rejected() now diagnoses top-level execution errors before indexing report fields.
Narrow regression asserts Unavailable, ToolFailed, code 23, original stderr, execution-finished-before-marker and AlreadyFinished; shared run_mode asserts complete cleanup and no pending cleanup.

independent_probe_setup_correction.observation: Initial reviewer wrapper placed the public peer executable without its sibling manifest; peer correctly failed to locate the manifest and returned ToolFailed/exit1 with complete cleanup. This was reviewer setup failure, not counted as a product regression or passing success-case test. Original stdout/stderr retained. Second probe copies the actual fixture manifest before invoking the fixed peer image.
